title: festuca myuros var. bromoides
intro:
Festuca myuros var. bromoides, commonly known as False Brome or False Brome Grass, is a type of plant species within the family Poaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca myuros var. bromoides include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe irritated tissues and prevent infection. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include flavonoids and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
